description: Phase 5 step 6 (build plan §4.2): two new, empty, platform-wide tables for push notifications: a person's devices (the address stored only sealed, plus a hash) and the kinds of notification they asked for. Nothing existing is altered. Additive: no row, account, email, phone, session, role or membership may change. Live traffic keeps writing while the migration runs, so the tables below are listed as volatile.
